bio.text: Floyd Griffin Jr. represents Georgia House District 149; the General Assembly's biography says he became the first African American to hold that seat in 2025.
According to the biography, Griffin was elected in 1994 after defeating an incumbent Georgia state senator, and in 2000 became the first African American mayor of Milledgeville.
Griffin earned a B.S. in Building Construction from Tuskegee University and a Master of Science in Contract and Procurement Management from the Florida Institute of Technology.
